heading: Development Workflow > Common Pitfalls
text:
1. **Don't Block Async Tasks**: Use `spawn_blocking` for CPU-intensive work or work with lots of blocking I/O
2. **Handle Errors Properly**: Use `?` operator and proper error types

heading: Writing Style > Formatting Conventions
text:
- **Bold** for UI elements.
- `Code style` for file names, folders, custom types, non-localizable text.
- Raw URLs in angle brackets.
- Use relative links for files in this repo.
- Remove `https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us` from learn.microsoft.com links.

heading: Development Workflow > Local Development
text:
1. Ensure Node.js 20+ is installed
2. Set `GITHUB_TOKEN` environment variable
3. Navigate to the directory you want to work with
4. Run `npm install` followed by `npm start`

heading: Common Tasks > Known Issues
text:
- **Network timeouts**: `make install` frequently encounters network timeouts with crates.io. This is normal in CI environments.
- **Memory constraints**: Full workspace build and test may fail with OOM or "No space left on device" errors in constrained environments.
- **Documentation generation**: `make docs` may fail due to disk space constraints.

Important Notes > Obsidian Plugin Environment
text: - **Global `app` variable**: In Obsidian plugins, `app` is a globally available variable that provides access to the Obsidian API. It's automatically available in all files without needing to import or declare it.

heading: Additional Development Information > Project Structure
text:
- `src/N98/Magento/Command/`: Contains all the commands
- `src/N98/Util/`: More general utility classes
- `src/N98/Magento/Application.php`: Main application class
- `config.yaml`: Configuration for commands and other settings
- `tests/N98`: Unit Test classes to cover src/N98 classes
- `tests/bats`: Functional tests using BATS (Bash Automated Testing System)
- `res/`: Resources like autocompletion files
- `bin/`: Executable scripts

heading: Code Architecture > Core Structure
text:
- **Main Class**: `CupertinoPane` in `/src/cupertino-pane.ts` - Primary API class
- **Settings**: Configuration managed through `/src/settings.ts` with TypeScript interfaces in `/src/models.ts`
- **Module System**: Modular architecture with feature modules in `/src/modules/`

heading: Common Development Tasks > Updating Language Grammar
text:
1. Modify `poml.tmLanguage.json`
2. Test in VS Code with sample files
3. Update syntax test cases

heading: Adding new prompts
text:
Ensure the instructions for the language model are clear and concise so that the language model can follow them reliably.
The prompts are located in the `src/prompts.ts` file.
